recordings.title: 2012 Subaru XV/Crosstrek 2.0i 6 speed manual acceleration 0-145km/h(0-90mph), with downshifts
recordings.uploader_description: 9.15-9.30-ish seconds to 100km/62mph. Subaru specs say around 10,5s to 100km/h with MT, 10,7s with CVT. If i didnt let it bounce off the limiter in first perhaps it would be 9s flat. It isnt fast, but it isnt slow either. For city driving quite fast as show by 0-50km/h time of 2.9-3 seconds, but even at taking it more gently and within 3-4k rpm its quite zippy especially of the line due to lack of any wheelspin.
